newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.10 pct in Feb 8-March 7.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.10 pct in Feb 8-March 7.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.10 percent between February 8 and March 7, slightly up from 0.01 percent in the previous four-week period, said a Fipe official.
Juarez Rizzieri, president of the Fipe institute, said a 1.09 percent increase in food prices led to higher inflation in the period.
Rizzieri said he expects March inflation to be below 0.5 percent.
The president of the Fipe institute also announced the following breakdown of its weighted inflation index for the period between February 8 and March 7:
- Food 1.09 pct rise in the period
- Housing 0.40 pct rise in the period
- Transportation -0.04 pct drop in the period
- Personal expenses 0.05 pct rise in the period
- Clothing -4.11 pct drop in the period
- Health care 0.69 pct rise in the period
- Education -0.13 pct drop in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures at weekly intervals.
